en: A vintage black‑and‑white waterfront view showing a busy harbor with several steamships and smaller boats docked along a quay. Crates and goods are stacked on the pier, with people walking and working. Across the water stands a large, ornate palace-like building and a dense row of multi‑story historic buildings behind it. The scene is urban and clearly northern European. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the location in Swedish.
